manifest_lint.logic: All stage numbers unique; all role/code/gate/validator refs exist; all schemas parse; status enum exists for every object code; graph has no dangling/duplicate direct edges; cycles require declared loop policy; split-plan keys unique.

object_schema_valid.logic: Validate RegistryEntry; validate payload against objects[code]; status in statusEnums[code]; object_id prefix matches code; content_hash matches canonical payload; additionalProperties policy respected.

typed_refs_exist.logic: Every ObjectRef resolves to exact immutable object_id+version and target is not hard-deleted; referenced code matches entry code.

mutation_permission.logic: Every operation is allowed by active role and stage contract; Reviewer cannot revise reviewed target; model cannot create AEV/HRES/BSL directly.

authority_within_policy.logic: A0/A1 closure matches applicable DPL rule and evidence requirements; A2/A3 closure requires OWNER AEV originating from selected QANS; A4 cannot close.

questionnaire_valid.logic: Selection-only; >=2 unique option_ids; default=null; JSONLogic condition only references prior answers; effects touch only referenced PD/DPL/scope fields and use allowlisted effect types; no hidden free-text input.

answers_valid.logic: Selected option ids exist, cardinality matches SINGLE/MULTI, all required visible questions answered exactly once.

answer_effects_valid.logic: Compiled mutations equal the selected option effects byte-for-byte after canonicalization; creates OWNER AEV; no unselected effect applied.

stage_ready_to_run.logic: Resolve each typed selector against one immutable input snapshot; meet required/min_count/status/version/stale constraints; required gate/baseline is committed.

independence_satisfied.logic: min_runs met; required distinct models met; all runs used identical input snapshot hash; isolated runs did not receive sibling outputs before fan-in.

dod_complete.logic: Evaluate all declared postcondition validators; every finding/escalation has an explicit route; no manual checkbox is source of truth.

gate_checklist_complete.logic: Execute each check validator/params; persisted checklist is only the result cache. pass iff all blocking checks pass.

no_open_blockers.logic: No matching entry has blocking=true and a status listed by the gate's per-code blocking_statuses.

all_required_statused.logic: Every selected object has a status in allowed_statuses; no required CANDIDATE/UNVERIFIED/PENDING remains.

trace_complete.logic: For every in-scope source object there is at least one typed-ref path satisfying required_path and all path entries are non-stale.

package_hash_identical.logic: All independent runs in the fan-out reference identical snapshot_id and snapshot_hash.

baseline_snapshot_valid.logic: All selectors resolve; gate passed on same snapshot; snapshot immutable; BSL content_refs exactly equal resolved selector set; canonical hash matches.

evidence_verifiable.logic: VERIFIED/FALSIFIED EVD has allowed method_kind, artifact_refs when required, exact target refs, executor compatible with method_kind. MODEL_ANALYSIS cannot confer VERIFIED.

human_test_execution_only.logic: Every HUMAN_TEST EVD has HRES+AEV from actor_type HUMAN_TESTER; model/tool runs cannot create HRES or claim HUMAN_TEST execution.

post_g1_autonomy_covered.logic: Every known normal-path decision kind that may occur after G1 maps to AUTO_POLICY or REQUIRE_EVIDENCE with deterministic closer; A2/A3 product/scope changes map to STOP/REOPEN, never silent continuation.

no_unresolved_blocking_findings.logic: No FND with blocking=true and status OPEN remains in scope.

chg_propagated.logic: For each APPLIED CHG, propagated_to covers computed impact_set and no dependent entry on superseded input remains non-stale.

falsified_assumption_has_change.logic: Every FALSIFIED ASM with dependents has an APPLIED/APPROVED CHG or all dependents have been superseded through the same invalidation event.

architecture_leakage_clear.logic: No blocking OPEN FND class=architecture_leakage created by stages 5/8/12 remains.

scope_coverage_complete.logic: Every required in-scope scenario/capability derived from IDEA/closed PD has CAP and at least one REQ; any excluded/deferred scope has explicit PD/UNK with non-blocking status.

direction_rationale_present.logic: Accepted direction references CMP candidates/criteria, has non-empty rationale, and selection is reproducible from active DPL or evidence rule.

adr_trace_complete.logic: Each in-scope REQ has path to accepted AD/ADR; evidence-dependent claims have path to EVD; non-evidence architectural choices have DPL authority path.

model_semantic_response_valid.description: Raw parsed LLM semantic response conforms to ModelSemanticResponse; reserved machine-owned fields are impossible because additionalProperties=false.
model_semantic_response_valid.logic: JSON Schema validation; reject unknown/reserved fields.

response_envelope_valid.description: Orchestrator-generated trusted envelope matches ResponseEnvelope and identity fields agree with the active run.
response_envelope_valid.logic: schema valid AND envelope.run_id/stage/snapshot/contract identity == active_run.

transport_completion_valid.description: Commit requires complete transport and parser completion; model self-reported EOF/TRUNCATED is ignored.

semantic_payload_hash_valid.description: Recompute SHA-256 over RFC8785/JCS canonical semantic_response and normalized mutations and compare with trusted integrity hashes.

stable_identity_valid.description: Models may use temp_id only for new same-response objects; canonical IDs are allocated by orchestrator, versions are monotonic and IDs are never reused.
stable_identity_valid.logic: all temp_id unique within response; all persisted refs canonical; revisions target current expected version; no canonical ID reuse.

provenance_complete.description: Every CREATE/MERGE/REVISE has semantic provenance refs; committed RegistryEntry provenance includes exact versioned inputs + trusted stage_run_id.
provenance_complete.logic: all semantic provenance refs exist in snapshot/allowed evidence; committed provenance is exact superset + stage_run_id.

disposition_complete.description: Every accountable transformation input has exactly one explicit model-authored domain disposition, and no foreign/duplicate input_ref exists.
disposition_complete.logic: resolve accountable_set in runtime; accountable_set == dispositions.input_ref set; duplicates/foreign==0; actions allowed by stage contract.

transformation_balance_valid.description: Declared dispositions reconcile exactly with input_fate + changes + frozen snapshot and produce unaccounted=0.
transformation_balance_valid.logic: apply coverageContracts@2.2.3 reconciliation rules; every declared disposition is supported by structural mutations/state transition and recomputed balance equals trusted integrity balance.

empty_result_valid.description: EMPTY_VALID is accepted only when stage contract permits empty semantic output, empty_reason_code is allowlisted and no required coverage/postcondition is violated.
empty_result_valid.logic: if EMPTY_VALID then operations empty AND reason allowlisted AND required obligations still satisfied.

preservation_contract_valid.description: EXACT inputs are referenced, not regenerated; SEMANTIC transformations require explicit mutation/provenance; NONE imposes no content preservation.
preservation_contract_valid.logic: EXACT => no payload rewrite of protected ref; SEMANTIC => any rewrite is explicit versioned mutation with provenance.

contract_identity_valid.description: Manifest, stage contract, prompt and response schema hashes in envelope equal the artifacts actually used for the executor call.
contract_identity_valid.logic: all identity/hash fields equal trusted compiled_call_record.

al_struct_1_valid.description: Transport extractor yields exactly one unambiguous JSON object and that canonical object conforms to AL-STRUCT-1 additionalProperties=false.
al_struct_1_valid.logic: deterministic extraction -> exactly one object -> JSON Schema validation; wrapper prose/code-fence is transport-only and never part of canonical semantic response.

al_struct_enums_closed.description: Critical AL-STRUCT-1 enum fields contain only declared values.

al_struct_internal_consistency.description: output_count/output_ids, trace refs, input_fate refs, dispositions refs/actions and changes.source_output_id are internally consistent.
al_struct_internal_consistency.logic: deterministic cross-reference validation including explicit disposition reconciliation for transformation stages

snapshot_hash_ack_valid.description: passport.input_snapshot_hash exactly equals the trusted ACTIVE input_snapshot_hash.
snapshot_hash_ack_valid.logic: exact equality after trusted normalization; model never computes hash

reference_first_valid.description: Existing canonical IDs/versions used by the model are present in passport.input_refs; new domain objects use tmp-*.
reference_first_valid.logic: reject invented canonical IDs/versions and out-of-snapshot references

reserved_runtime_fields_absent.description: Model-controlled response contains no runtime-owned fields such as run_id/response_id/object_id/content_hash/prompt_hash/transport_complete.

empty_by_design_valid.description: Empty outputs accepted only when stage allows it, reason is allowlisted, output_count=0 and stage postconditions/coverage hold.

context_budget_valid.description: Rendered prompt fits policy after allowed context-only compaction; required refs/fields were never silently evicted.

source_message_idempotent.description: A transport-owned provider source_message_id can be accepted at most once.

context_audit_reproducible.description: Stored assembly recipe deterministically reproduces included/omitted/truncated refs, budget, snapshot hash and prompt hash.
context_audit_reproducible.logic: re-run context assembler and compare recipe/hashes

role_no_arbitration.description: A model role constrains permitted output but never authorizes overriding/evaluating sibling authority absent explicit stage contract.
role_no_arbitration.logic: reject authority escalation inferred solely from role

annotation_non_authoritative.description: annotations[] are diagnostic-only and cannot change validation, policy, mutations, status, gates or commit.
annotation_non_authoritative.logic: ignore annotations for all authoritative computations; preserve only in RAW/audit/UI.

mutation_normalization_valid.description: Every accepted AL-STRUCT-1 change normalizes deterministically into permitted internal mutations.
mutation_normalization_valid.logic: apply mutationNormalizer@2.2.3; reject ambiguous/unauthorized state_patch; no prose/annotation inference.

decomposition_coverage_valid.description: For decomposed stages, persisted partitions cover the full selector set exactly as declared and each partition satisfies its coverage obligation.
decomposition_coverage_valid.logic: deterministic partition union/overlap checks + stage-specific coverage obligation.

hash_format_valid.description: All canonical SHA-256 identity/integrity fields use lowercase bare 64-hex.
hash_format_valid.logic: regex ^[a-f0-9]{64}$; reject sha256: prefix in canonical/model-echo fields.

compact_prompt_contract_valid.description: Model prompt receives the compact AL-STRUCT-1 prompt contract, not the full JSON Schema, and the embedded full_schema_hash matches the validator schema.
compact_prompt_contract_valid.logic: prompt contract ref/hash match; prompt contract size <= configured limit; full schema is validator-side only unless explicit diagnostic mode.

structured_response_extraction_valid.description: Correlated assistant text yields exactly one semantic JSON object using the deterministic transport extraction policy.
structured_response_extraction_valid.logic: accept WHOLE_TEXT_JSON or SINGLE_FENCED_JSON only; reject zero/multiple/ambiguous candidates; never parse authoritative JSON from innerHTML.
